name: argus-control-center
description: Mission control for Claude Code: a live board of your sessions, notifications when one needs you, PR and worktree tracking, diff review, Claude plan usage in the status bar, and plugins.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Argus runs git and gh in your workspace and installs hooks into your Claude Code settings.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Argus needs local files and the git and gh CLIs.

commands.title: Argus: Open Chats Side by Side

argus.sessions.prRefreshMinutes.description: How often PR states refresh in the background, for session cards.

argus.sessions.retentionDays.description: Session record files for sessions that are no longer open are deleted once they have not been updated for this many days.

enumDescriptions: Only show sessions whose folder, or git repo and worktrees, belongs to this window's workspace folders.
Only show sessions whose folder (or a linked worktree) is inside this window's workspace folders; other folders of the same git repo are left out.
Show every Claude Code session on this machine in every window.
argus.sessions.scope.description: Which sessions this VS Code window shows. Set it in Workspace settings to choose per window. With no folder open, all sessions are shown.

argus.keepAwake.whileAgentsRun.description: Stop this machine sleeping while any Claude session in this window is working or scheduled, and for 2 minutes after. Uses a Windows power request, caffeinate on macOS, or systemd-inhibit on Linux. Closing the lid still sleeps it.

argus.keepAwake.keepScreenOn.description: While keeping the machine awake, keep the screen on too. Needed on Windows laptops with Modern Standby, which go to sleep when the screen turns off.

enumDescriptions: Notify when a session needs permission, asks a question, or finishes.
Only when a session needs permission or asks a question.
argus.notifications.description: Show a VS Code notification, with a button to open the session, when a Claude Code session in this window starts waiting on you.

argus.prs.cacheSeconds.description: How long a fetched PR state is reused before gh is called again, in seconds.

argus.usage.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Claude plan usage in the status bar. Reads the sign-in Claude Code stores on this machine (`~/.claude/.credentials.json`, or the macOS keychain) and sends it only to Anthropic's undocumented usage endpoint (`api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage`). On by default; turn off to stop reading the sign-in.

argus.usage.refreshMinutes.description: How often Claude plan usage refreshes in the background.

argus.plugins.paths.markdownDescription: Extra plugin folders to load, on top of every folder in `~/.claude/argus/plugins`. Each entry is one plugin folder containing an `argus-plugin.json`. Use it to run a plugin straight from a git checkout. `~` is expanded.

argus.plugins.config.markdownDescription: Settings for locally installed Argus plugins, keyed by plugin id: `"argus.plugins.config": { "my-plugin": { "someSetting": "value" } }`. A plugin's README should list its keys. User and workspace scopes are merged key by key.

argus.diffReview.baseRef.description: Base to diff against. Empty uses origin/HEAD, then origin/main, origin/master, main, master.

argus.diffReview.contextLines.description: Unchanged lines shown around each change in the diff review.

argus.chat.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` executable Argus chat runs. Empty: `claude` on your PATH, then `~/.local/bin`, where Claude Code's installer puts it. **Argus: Install Claude Code** installs it.

argus.chat.askForFolder.markdownDescription: In a window with several workspace folders, ask which folder each new Argus chat starts in. Off: new chats start in the first workspace folder, like the Claude Code extension.

argus.chat.experimentalMultiAgent.markdownDescription: Experiment: several agents on one task, shown side by side in one tab. Adds **+ Agent**, the board's **add to grid**, and opening a group's card as a grid. Off: forks open in their own tab.

argus.chat.textOnlyDefault.markdownDescription: Open chats in Text only view (your messages and Claude's replies, tool calls hidden). The Text only button in a chat still switches it, and each chat remembers its own choice.

argus.chat.hiddenModels.markdownDescription: Models to leave out of the chat's model picker, by name as shown (e.g. `Haiku 4.5`) or id (e.g. `claude-opus-4-6`, `haiku`). A chat's current model always stays listed. Applies to chats opened after the change.

argus.chat.backgroundIdleMinutes.markdownDescription: How long a chat with no open tab keeps its Claude process after it goes idle. While it runs, other agents can message it and its timers keep firing. A chat that is working or waiting on you is never stopped. `0` stops it as soon as its turn ends.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No Claude Code sessions yet.
